scope: Scoped visual QA of final integrated RH and guide PDFs for the arithmetic supplier checkpoint.

page_reviews.finding: Integral paired-detection statement and full proof fit the page. Displayed coefficient algebra, action/trace formulas, superscripts and primes are legible; no visible clipping or overlap.
Ordinary local count and uniform-bound proposition are legible. The scalar-count equation number, Tate-pairing subscripts and typed multiplicities fit the text area. The proof continues on page 44.

Adjacent continuation inspected: the full local-bound proof starts cleanly at the top and concludes before the next subsection. The page break after the proposition is natural; no stranded heading or damaged formula.

Signed arithmetic boundary comparison and proof are legible, including q-normalization, the fixed polynomial, finite-energy inequality and final signed mean. Equations fit the page and the proof closes normally.
Signed-density refinement and scalar-pair density proposition are legible. The designated modified frame tuple, Gram determinant and divided congruence display fit. The proof continues on page 91.

Adjacent continuation inspected: the complement and discriminant-module argument concludes cleanly before the next subsection. The quotient-isomorphism display and corank discussion are intact; no clipping or missing symbols.

Geometric progress paragraph and trace-error formulas are legible. The page explicitly retains model, lattice, height and arithmetic section inputs. No visible clipping, overlapping text or broken mathematical glyphs.
Supplier summary and ordinary-RH discussion are legible. Headings, list continuation and the signed-character equations fit the page; no visible clipping, missing symbols or stranded heading.

overall_findings: No visible clipping, overlapping equations, missing mathematical glyphs or broken equation displays on the inspected pages.
Adjacent RH pages 44 and 91 were additionally inspected to verify continuation of the ordinary local and scalar-pair density proofs. Both continuations are readable.
Final PDF hashes were checked before rendering and again after image inspection; the files did not change.
limitations: Only RH physical pages 40,43,44,57,90,91 and guide physical pages 5,7 were visually inspected.
